name: Nitrogen Deficiency
description: Nitrogen is essential for chlorophyll production and vegetative growth. Deficiency causes uniform yellowing of older leaves and stunted growth across all crop types.
symptoms: Uniform pale green to yellow color on older leaves
Yellowing starting at leaf tips and progressing backward
Stunted plant growth with thin stems
Reduced leaf size and overall plant vigor
Delayed flowering and poor fruit development
causes: Leaching of nitrogen by heavy rainfall or irrigation
Low organic matter content in soil
High carbon-to-nitrogen ratio from crop residue incorporation
Sandy soils with poor nutrient retention
treatments: Apply nitrogen fertilizer (urea, CAN, NPK) at recommended rates
Foliar spray of urea solution (2%) for quick correction
Side-dress nitrogen during vegetative growth stage
Apply organic sources like well-decomposed manure
prevention: Apply balanced fertilizer based on crop requirements
Use split application of nitrogen for better efficiency
Incorporate organic matter into soil regularly
Practice crop rotation with nitrogen-fixing legumes
